description: This Java source file defines the class SubscriptionHasNextPage, representing an event emitted after a page of search results is ready in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and for manipulating event data.

classes.name: SubscriptionHasNextPage
classes.description: An immutable event class representing a 'next page' of search results in the Ditto framework, with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and header management.

classes.name: SubscriptionHasNextPage.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions specific to SubscriptionHasNextPage, notably the 'items' array.

methods.name: SubscriptionHasNextPage.of
methods.description: Creates a new SubscriptionHasNextPage instance with specified subscription ID, items, and headers.

methods.name: SubscriptionHasNextPage.fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a SubscriptionHasNextPage instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the JSON array of items in the next page of search results.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Creates a copy of the event with a new items JSON array.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path for this event, which is empty.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new event instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the 'items' JSON array to the event's JSON payload.
